replaces.text:
Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the vict'ry
Thou o'er death hast won.

Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the vict'ry
Thou o'er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment
Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded graveclothes
Where Thy body lay.
